name: a terminal boot sequence opens the film
looks: A thin instrument HUD frames the whole edge of the dark frame -- small corner readouts, a status bar, a timecode -- while a single line of command-line text types on in the centre: a boot command, then two status lines confirming the system is online, each with a small ok tag.
build: DOM monospace text revealed per character at a steady rate with a blinking block cursor; two status lines fade in below once the boot line completes, each with a small coloured ok tag; a persistent HUD layer (corner labels, a scene counter, a running timecode) sits above for the whole shot.
sound: A soft mechanical key tick per character, a short confirm tone on each status line landing.
prompt: Open cold on a terminal boot: a command types on character by character with a blinking cursor inside a thin instrument HUD frame, followed by a couple of short status lines confirming the system is alive. Let the HUD chrome (corner labels, a timecode) persist as the frame for the rest of the film.
